source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #7-22: The Handmaiden's Gaze

items.name: Prepared for Hell
items.text: The Marauders have come prepared to fight devils and the damage from Short Salvo and Slashing Blades is silver. The damage from Punitive Attack is also silver, if the troop possesses that ability.

items.name: Short Salvo
items.text: The Marauders draw and fire a barrage of arrows from their shortbows. The salvo is a 10-foot burst within 60 feet that deals 4d8 piercing damage (DC 27 basic Reflex save save). When the Marauders are reduced to 2 segments, this area decreases to a 5-foot burst.

items.name: Slashing Blades
items.text:
Frequency once per round

---
Effect The Marauders attack each enemy in a 5-foot emanation with their swords, with a DC 27 basic Reflex save save. The damage depends on the number of actions.

1 2d6+3 slashing damage

2 4d6+7 slashing damage

3 5d6+10 slashing damage
